description: Provide an exact owner/repository or GitHub repository URL to retrieve GitHub API metadata and activity counters. Returns repository identity, available counts, source dates, capture time and quota/cache metadata. Missing counters remain unknown and cached responses preserve original timestamps. This snapshot does not audit repository security, code quality, organic adoption or future activity. [x402: 0.03 USDC per call on Base; first 1 calls free]
name: github_repo_activity
